# Traveled Roads Tracker

> Traveled Roads Tracker is a client-side Angular web application for tracking family road trips, visited US and Canadian National Parks, and visited US States and Canadian Provinces.

## AI Trip Import & Trip Delta Schema

Traveled Roads Tracker supports natural language trip logging. When a user describes their travel experience, an AI can parse the locations, dates, notes, and family members, and produce a structured JSON object according to the **Trip Delta schema**.

### The Trip Delta Format

```json
{
  "type": "trip_delta",
  "version": 1,
  "trip": {
    "name": "Trip Title (e.g. Yellowstone & Grand Tetons Road Trip)",
    "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "members": ["all"],
    "parks": ["Yellowstone", "Grand Teton"],
    "states": ["Montana", "Wyoming", "Idaho"],
    "notes": "Route notes or highlights"
  }
}
```

### Schema Rules & Specifications
- **`parks`**: Array of canonical US and Canadian National Park names (e.g., "Yellowstone", "Grand Teton", "Banff", "Acadia", "Zion", "Glacier"). Do not include prefixes/suffixes like "National Park and Preserve".
- **`states`**: Array of US States or Canadian Provinces visited, including arrival/departure transit states. Accepts full names (e.g. "Montana", "Wyoming", "British Columbia") or standard 2-letter postal codes (e.g. "MT", "WY", "BC").
- **`members`**: Array of group member first names, or `["all"]` if the entire group attended.
- **`date`**: ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. If only year is given, use `YYYY-06-01`. If only month/year is given, use `YYYY-MM-01`.
- **`notes`**: Brief 1-2 sentence description of the trip.
